name: ubuntu/deb-package
title: .deb package build
summary: Build script and control files that package a program as a .deb.
when: Use when the program has to be installable on other Ubuntu machines with apt.

name.about: Package name, lower case, no spaces.

version.about: Package version in Debian form, digits and dots.

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, copy the user's program into payload/ (replacing the stub), then run ./build.sh and report the .deb path it prints.
